assets.prompt: Reference image: the character igris from Solo Leveling, only use it for exact identity, armor, head, silhouette, sword, red plume or white hair and wing details. Create a NEW production animation sheet, 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly SIXTEEN fully isolated complete drawings on genuinely transparent background. Refined anime cel animation with bright readable armor highlights. ALL figures face RIGHT in strict consistent SIDE PROFILE so both feet and knee bends are visible, identical size and proportions. NOT sixteen similar static strides: make a real biomechanical alternating gait. TOP TWO ROWS read left-to-right then next row: an EIGHT-frame seamless WALK cycle, frames 1 left foot forward/right back heel contact, 2 left stance compress down, 3 right swinging leg passes stance leg with bent knee, 4 right swing rises and extends, 5 RIGHT foot forward/left back contact, 6 right stance compress, 7 LEFT swinging leg passes with bent knee, 8 left swing rises and extends, returning naturally to frame1. BOTTOM TWO ROWS: EIGHT-frame RUN cycle with clear alternate left and right contacts, recoil compression, passing, airborne extension, then opposite contact/recoil/passing/airborne. Arms counter-swing opposite the legs, armor maintains volume; red plume/hair/cape trails with secondary follow-through, not stiff. Full body head and toes uncropped in EVERY cell, huge clear transparent gaps between ALL cells, capes and sword kept inside own cell. Character is walking/running in place on an invisible level ground with both foot soles at a consistent baseline. Avoid diffuse glow joining cells. NO background gradient, colored haze, floor, text, grid, shadows, detached particles, extra people, aura or effects. Keep character unmistakably matching the reference but make all sixteen poses genuinely distinct.
